description: METRO MONDEGO NETEX is a dataset listed in data.gov.pt, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by AGIT (Agência para a Gestão do Sistema Intermodal da Região de Coimbra) . Welcome to the official documentation of Metro Mondego's operating data access endpoints. This interface is designed to provide structured, reliable and up-to-date access to all public information relating to the Mondego Mobility System (MMS). Coverage: AGIT (Agência para a Gestão do Sistema Intermodal da Região de Coimbra) . The publisher named on the listing is AGIT (Agência para a Gestão do Sistema Intermodal da Região de Coimbra) . Its keywords include mobilidade, transporte. The listing shows 5 download or service links in ZIP. The listing shows 2026-08-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-dados-gov-pt.
